mapper.select: /* QueryID=kkdugi.core.security.mapper.SecurityUserDetailsMapper.findAuthoritiesByUsername */ SELECT ab.auth_id, ab.auth_role_cd AS authority, ab.auth_tp_cd, ab.auth_nm FROM kkdugi_user_auth ua JOIN kkdugi_user_base ub ON ub.user_id = ua.user_id JOIN kkdugi_auth_base ab ON ab.auth_id = ua.auth_id WHERE ub.user_login_id = #{username} AND ab.use_yn = 'Y' AND CURRENT_DATE BETWEEN ua.apl_st_dtm AND ua.apl_ed_dtm
